activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1918 as Ramanujan's representative British mathematical-activity year. During his Cambridge period he published major joint work with G. H. Hardy and was elected a Fellow of the Royal Society on 2 May 1918.

sources.title: Revisiting Ramanujan — Royal Society
sources.citation_text: The Royal Society records Ramanujan's Cambridge research, a major 1918 paper with Hardy, and his election as a Fellow of the Royal Society on 2 May 1918.
